title: Formal etaleness at a prime is detected by localized cotangent groups
statement: For commutative rings R and S with an R-algebra structure on S [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and a prime ideal q of S, the localization S_q [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is formally etale over R if and only if the localizations (H_1(L_{S/R}))_q and (Omega_{S/R})_q [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] are both zero.
